_comment: Maps cwd substrings to domain preflight skills. session-start-cwd-router.sh checks each key as a case-insensitive substring of $CWD; first match wins. Keys use forward slashes; cwd is normalized to forward slashes before matching. Add a new entry per project domain — keep the substring distinctive enough that unrelated dirs don't false-match.

_example.description: Example only (keys starting with _ are ignored). Copy this entry, rename the key to a distinctive substring of your project's path, and point it at the preflight skill that should load when a session starts there.
